question_text: The exponential function $y = a \times 2^x + b$ passes through the points alongside: $\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline y & 20 & p & 35 & q \\ \hline \end{array}$

subparts.stem: Write down two linear equations which could be used to determine the values of $a$ and $b$.
subparts.solution: When $x = 0$, $y = 20 \implies 20 = a \times 2^0 + b \implies a + b = 20 \quad \text{--- (1)}$. When $x = 2$, $y = 35 \implies 35 = a \times 2^2 + b \implies 4a + b = 35 \quad \text{--- (2)}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Substitute known coordinate pairs into the general formula to set up a system of linear equations in $a$ and $b$.

subparts.stem: Solve the linear equations simultaneously to find $a$ and $b$.
subparts.solution: Using (1), $b = 20 - a \quad \text{--- (3)}$. Substituting $b = 20 - a$ into (2) gives $4a + 20 - a = 35 \implies 3a = 15 \implies a = 5$. Substituting $a = 5$ into (3) gives $b = 20 - 5 = 15$. Therefore, $a = 5$ and $b = 15$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Solve simultaneous linear equations by substitution or elimination.
step_by_step: Subtract equation (1) from equation (2): $(4a + b) - (a + b) = 35 - 20 \implies 3a = 15$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Arithmetic errors when subtracting negative numbers.

subparts.stem: Hence find the values of $p$ and $q$.
subparts.solution:
Using part b, $y = 5 \times 2^x + 15$.
When $x = 1$, $y = p \implies p = 5 \times 2^1 + 15 = 10 + 15 = 25$.
When $x = 3$, $y = q \implies q = 5 \times 2^3 + 15 = 5 \times 8 + 15 = 40 + 15 = 55$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Evaluate the fully determined model $y = 5 \times 2^x + 15$ at given $x$-values.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Calculating $5 \times 2^3$ as $(5 \times 2)^3 = 1000$ instead of following order of operations.
